args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isVideo=()=>/bilibili\.com\/video\/BV/.test(location.href);if(target&&!(isVideo()&&location.href.indexOf(target.split('?')[0])>=0)){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isVideo())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}if(!isVideo())return {ok:false,error:'not-on-video-page',hint:'当前标签不在B站视频页（bilibili.com/video/BV...）；请先打开视频页再运行本模板，或通过 params.url 传入视频链接。'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const bvid=(location.href.match(/BV[0-9A-Za-z]+/)||[])[0];if(!bvid)return {ok:false,error:'no-bvid'};const pl=await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/pagelist?bvid='+bvid,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json());if(pl.code!==0||!pl.data||!pl.data.length)return {ok:false,error:'pagelist-failed',detail:pl.message||('code '+pl.code)};const page=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number('$page')||1,pl.data.length));const cid=pl.data[page-1].cid;const api='https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/playurl?bvid='+bvid+'&cid='+cid+'&qn=116&platform=html5&high_quality=1';const pj=await fetch(api,{credentials:'include'}).then(r=>r.json());if(pj.code!==0||!pj.data||!pj.data.durl||!pj.data.durl[0])return {ok:false,error:'playurl-failed',detail:pj.message||('code '+pj.code),hint:'该视频可能不支持HTML5单文件导出（互动视频/充电专属/版权限制等）'};const du=pj.data.durl[0];if(du.size>2147483648)return {ok:false,error:'too-large',sizeMB:Math.round(du.size/1048576),hint:'超过2GB上限，请选择更短的视频或分P'};const blob=await fetch(du.url).then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.blob();});const title=(document.title.replace(/_哔哩哔哩[_ ]?bilibili.*$/i,'').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,'_').trim())||bvid;const QMAP={16:'360P',32:'480P',64:'720P',74:'720P60',80:'1080P',112:'1080P+'};const q=QMAP[pj.data.quality]||((pj.data.format||'mp4').replace(/^mp4/,'')+'P');const filename=title+'_'+q+'.mp4';const objUrl=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=objUrl;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(()=>{a.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(objUrl);},120000);return {ok:true,downloaded:true,filename:filename,sizeMB:Math.round(blob.size/1048576*10)/10,quality:pj.data.quality,page:page,bvid:bvid,title:title};})()

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));let mid=want('$mid');if(!mid){let navr=null;for(let att=0;att<3&&!navr;att++){try{const r=await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav',{credentials:'include'}).then(x=>x.json());if(r.data&&r.data.mid)navr=String(r.data.mid);}catch{await sleep(800);}}mid=navr||'';}if(!mid)return {ok:false,error:'no-login',hint:'未获取到登录 mid（收藏夹需要B站登录态）'};if(location.href.indexOf('/'+mid+'/favlist')<0){location.href='https://space.bilibili.com/'+mid+'/favlist';const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!/favlist/.test(location.href))await sleep(400);}await sleep(2500);const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||30,100));const collect=()=>{const byUrl=new Map();for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/video/BV"]')){const m=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').match(/BV[0-9A-Za-z]+/);if(!m)continue;const url='https://www.bilibili.com/video/'+m[0];const t=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const prev=byUrl.get(url);if(!prev||t.length>prev.title.length)byUrl.set(url,{title:t.slice(0,120),bvid:m[0],url:url});}return byUrl;};let byUrl=collect();const maxRounds=Math.max(4,Math.min(20,Math.ceil(lim/10)+3));for(let i=0;i<maxRounds&&byUrl.size<lim;i++){const before=byUrl.size;for(let y=0;y<=document.body.scrollHeight;y+=700){window.scrollTo(0,y);await sleep(150);}await sleep(900+Math.floor(Math.random()*300));byUrl=collect();if(byUrl.size>=lim)break;if(byUrl.size===before&&i>1)break;}window.scrollTo(0,0);await sleep(400);return {ok:true,mid:mid,count:byUrl.size,videos:[...byUrl.values()].slice(0,lim)};})()

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const keyword=want('$query');const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||10,100));const maxP=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$maxPages'))||3,5));const isCover=(t)=>/^稍后再看/.test(t)||/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(t);const extract=(root)=>{const out=[];const seen=new Set();for(const c of root.querySelectorAll('.bili-video-card')){const links=[...c.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/video/BV']")];if(!links.length)continue;let href=links[0].getAttribute('href')||'';let url=href.startsWith('//')?('https:'+href):href;try{url=new URL(url,location.href).href;}catch{}if(seen.has(url))continue;const titEl=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--tit');let title=titEl?(titEl.textContent||'').trim():'';if(!title){const t=links.map(x=>(x.textContent||'').trim()).find(x=>x.length>2&&!isCover(x));title=t||'';}if(!title||title.length<2)continue;seen.add(url);const owner=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--owner');const author=owner?(owner.textContent||'').split('·')[0].trim().slice(0,40):'';out.push({title:title.slice(0,150),url:url,author:author});}return out;};const start=Date.now();let links=[];while(Date.now()-start<12000){links=extract(document);if(links.length>=3)break;await sleep(400);}let pages=1;const base='https://search.bilibili.com/all?keyword='+encodeURIComponent(keyword||'');while(links.length<lim&&pages<maxP){const next=base+'&page='+(pages+1);await sleep(1400+Math.floor(Math.random()*800));let html=null;try{const r=await fetch(next,{credentials:'include'});if(!r.ok)break;html=await r.text();}catch{break;}if(!html||html.length<500)break;let doc=null;try{doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,'text/html');}catch{break;}const seen=new Set(links.map(x=>x.url));const added=extract(doc);let grew=0;for(const it of added){if(links.length>=lim)break;if(!seen.has(it.url)){links.push(it);grew++;}}pages++;if(!grew)break;}return {count:links.length,links:links.slice(0,lim),pages:pages,text:(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,6000).trim()};})()

args.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const lim=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number(want('$limit'))||10,100));const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const extract=()=>{const seen=new Set();return [...document.querySelectorAll('.timeline__item')].map(it=>{const author=((it.querySelector('.user-name')||{}).textContent||'').trim().slice(0,40);const d=it.querySelector('.date-and-source');const href=d?d.getAttribute('href'):null;const c=it.querySelector('[class*=content]');const nums=[...it.querySelectorAll('.timeline__item__control')].map(e=>parseInt((e.textContent||'').trim())||0);return href?{author:author,time:(d.textContent||'').trim().slice(0,30),url:'https://xueqiu.com'+href,excerpt:((c?c.textContent:'')).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,120),reposts:nums[0]||0,replies:nums[1]||0,likes:nums[2]||0}:null;}).filter(x=>x&&x.url&&!seen.has(x.url)&&seen.add(x.url));};let posts=extract();for(let i=0;i<15&&posts.length<lim;i++){const before=posts.length;window.scrollTo(0,document.body.scrollHeight);await sleep(900+Math.floor(Math.random()*400));posts=extract();if(posts.length>=lim)break;if(posts.length===before&&i>1)break;}window.scrollTo(0,0);await sleep(300);return {ok:true,count:posts.length,posts:posts.slice(0,lim),loaded:posts.length};})()
